scientific_integrity: An all-dimensional algebraic proof is provided. Finite GF(2) and GF(4) checks supplement but do not replace it. Literature comparison has residual risk of an unindexed equivalent statement.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed fields of characteristic two; cubic e3; n at least three and not congruent to two modulo four. No assertion for excluded positive-dimensional case or other degrees.
title: Nodes and doubled Jacobian points of the elementary symmetric cubic in characteristic two
